name: Husky Falling off Couch — Clumsy Pet Moment
description: A husky dog is playing on a leather couch next to its owner, who is distracted by her phone. The dog accidentally rolls off the couch and falls into the gap between the sofa and the wall, startling the owner.

metadata.subject: husky dog / couch slip / distracted owner
metadata.visual_summary: A husky dog rolls off a leather couch into the gap next to the wall while the distracted owner jumps up in panic.
